ai_content.desc_en: In a world filled with bitterness and hardship, a strong-willed woman discovers herself in danger when she becomes entangled in a relationship with a man who harbors a profound secret. As she navigates what follows, she will discover that hearts can be broken, exceeded, and exceeded. In the end, she will discover that the heart is the one that holds the real power.
